changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetField_backup') BEGIN drop table integration.AssetField_backup; END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetField_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[AssetField_backup]( [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Section] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [FieldValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationAssetField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [SourceID] ASC, [Section] ASC, [FieldName] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_Include] ON [integration].[AssetField_backup] ( [Section] ASC ) INCLUDE([FieldValue]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include] ON [integration].[AssetField_backup] ( [Section] ASC, [SourceID] ASC ) INCLUDE([FieldValue]) END
